cards.public_claim: IREN disclosed a five-year Microsoft GPU-cloud agreement with an approximately $9.7bn headline contract value.
cards.evidence_boundary: The disclosure was furnished by IREN. Headline contract value is not recognized revenue or cash collected.
cards.what_remains_unknown: The boundary remains unresolved in the reviewed source set.
cards.what_would_change_it: Review any amendment, termination, delivery, revenue-recognition, or collection disclosure.

cards.public_claim: IREN stated that Horizon 1 was delivered to and accepted by Microsoft in August 2026 and that NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status was achieved on GB300 NVL72.
cards.evidence_boundary: This is issuer-reported acceptance in a furnished exhibit, not a Microsoft-authored acceptance record or independent NVIDIA certification record captured by this tracker.
cards.what_remains_unknown: The boundary remains unresolved in the reviewed source set.
cards.what_would_change_it: Seek a customer-authored or independently attributable acceptance artifact.

cards.public_claim: Contracted ARR has converted into the same amount of GAAP recognized revenue.
cards.evidence_boundary: Contracted ARR, operating ARR, recognized revenue, deferred revenue, prepayments, and cash are different measures.
cards.what_remains_unknown: Not shown in the sources reviewed: contracted ARR converting dollar-for-dollar into GAAP revenue.
cards.what_would_change_it: Compare subsequent filed AI Cloud revenue and notes with the exact ARR definition then in use.
